analysis.title: US Rates: Whipsawing Narratives The Name Of The Game
key_insights: Rates sold off 25-30bp about 1.5 weeks ago on Governor Waller's comment on a 50bp hike plus hot CPI and payroll prints, and most of that move was retraced last week as the equity/AI story got rattled.
Equity investors describe the equity move as more technical, with dip-buying interest, but the desk says it feels like catching a falling knife.
Headline risk exists from President Trump considering new Iran strikes as the US military warns of strain on forces.
Post-Waller flow favored January vs March FOMC and December vs January steepeners, and these are now being exited. The STRIP fell 15-20bp on Friday alone and Z6Z7 flattened about 20bp last week.
Market is asking what equity move threshold could put the Fed on hold in December. The desk thinks the rally is a bit overdone given core PCE and GDP strength and sees room for a retracement.
USD spreads positioning is long on the Street. Hedge funds trimmed long spreads this week, real money is on the sidelines in the belly, and foreign accounts are receiving in swaps.
CTAs had added short duration above 5% in 10s and are probably covering with 10s back at 4.85-4.95%.
Vol: Street runs a long gamma bias that has worked. The top left is up 13-15nv while deep vega is down, with 10y10y down 0.8nv and 10y20y down 1nv.
Spot-vol correlations differ between top left and top right. Deep vega is driven by exotic desks short into the sell-off needing to buy, vega is rich, and gamma skew is inverted.
Customer flows were two-way in gamma and calendars including 3m5y and 10y tails, with buying in 1y30y vs selling the 3m line.
